# Real model test inputs

These are Google's MediaPipe test assets, downloaded from the official `mediapipe-assets` bucket (`portrait.jpg`, `right_hands.jpg`). They are used only by automated tests and are excluded from the production site. Upstream MediaPipe is Apache-2.0; see the repository's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and public/models/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt. A test with a still image verifies real model outputs, not live webcam interaction.
